title: Advancing the Full Available Credit on Operating Lines of Credit
content:
A member may ask for as much as one of their Operating Lines of Credit will advance.

## Rule

When a member asks for as much as the line will advance, the advance is the line's available credit on the day of the request, booked by phone with the proceeds deposited to the member's checking account.

On a line whose AutoDraft was cancelled after returned payments, the amount of an advance is not fixed until the line's records show AutoDraft enrolled again.

On a product that requires a borrowing base, an advance is booked only when its effective date is no later than the product's certificate staleness period, in calendar days, after the as-of date of the line's most recent certificate, that as-of date being day 0; on a product that requires none, no certificate enters the advance.

## Business effect

The advance is booked as one advance requested by phone, effective today, with the proceeds deposited to the member's checking account, and the line's outstanding principal rises by its amount. The member then sees the advance in the line's transaction history and the higher principal on the line.

## Platform reference: `book_operating_advance_f71c3718`

**Capability.** Books an advance of principal on an operating line requested by phone, with the proceeds deposited to the member's checking account. One call books one advance of the stated amount, effective today, and raises the line's outstanding principal by that amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `book_operating_advance_f71c3718` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `line_id` | Loan number of the operating line the advance is drawn on, as shown when the member's operating lines are looked up | Identifier |
| `amount` | The principal advanced | USD, always positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to cents before it is passed |

**Return.** A receipt rendered as text with `txn_id` (reference number of the advance), `line_id` (the line drawn on), `amount` (the USD advance, 2 decimal places), `effective_date` (today's date, in year-month-day form), `disbursement_method` (the literal "deposit_to_checking"), `outstanding_principal` (the line's principal after the advance, USD, 2 decimal places) and `status`, the literal "booked", meaning the advance is on the line.

## Contract questions

**Through which channel and delivery is the advance booked?** By phone, with the proceeds deposited to the member's checking account.

**Which date does the advance take?** Today, the day it is booked.
